name: Dark brown grained leather (designer photo)

source.license: supplied by the designer for Perhaps packaging

height.note: grain and creases; distance chosen, not measured

measured.note: photo crop mean [0.0254, 0.0122, 0.0074] lifted to luminance 0.022 (same hue), sRGB about #37251B

limitations: Built from one draped photo: relief is the lighting-flattened luminance of rows 860-1260 only, not a height scan.
Mirrored 2 x 2: the tile is 200 x 109 mm, so a 100 mm face shows one horizontal mirror line.
Physical scale assumed: 100 mm across the photo.
Mean lifted about 1.5x above the photo's own so the box reads on black.
